description: As a proud member of the Affiliated by Meliá network—an international-standard hotel line by Meliá Hotels International—Vinpearl Cua Sot Resort, Affiliated by Meliá offers a world-class retreat set amidst untouched nature. Featuring 42 private villas, a spacious swimming pool, the serene YHI Spa, and a location adjacent to Vinpear Water Park Ha Tinh, the resort is the perfect destination for relaxation and connection. Notably, Vinpearl Cua Sot Resort, Affiliated by Meliá has been honored with the “Tripadvisor Travelers’ Choice Best of the Best 2025” award in the Luxury Hotels Vietnam category, earning a perfect 5.0 rating—a testament to its exceptional service quality and the high satisfaction of countless guests.

A world-class seaside retreat nestled in a pristine coastal haven
As a proud member of the Affiliated by Meliá network—an international-standard hotel line by Meliá Hotels International—Vinpearl Cua Sot Resort, Affiliated by Meliá offers a world-class retreat set amidst untouched nature. Featuring 42 private villas, a spacious swimming pool, the serene YHI Spa, and a location adjacent to Vinpear Water Park Ha Tinh, the resort is the perfect destination for relaxation and connection. Notably, Vinpearl Cua Sot Resort, Affiliated by Meliá has been honored with the “Tripadvisor Travelers’ Choice Best of the Best 2025” award in the Luxury Hotels Vietnam category, earning a perfect 5.0 rating—a testament to its exceptional service quality and the high satisfaction of countless guests.
2-Bedroom Villa With Private Pool
Nestled in a peaceful, lush setting, this spacious villa features two bedrooms, a separate living area, and a private pool—offering absolute privacy and comfort. Ideal for families or groups of friends seeking a serene and memorable escape by the tranquil shores of Xuan Hai Beach.
3-Bedroom Villa With Private Pool
Spacious and inviting, this villa is ideal for extended families or groups of friends. It features three well-appointed bedrooms, a separate living and dining area, and a private pool—offering the perfect blend of comfort, privacy, and relaxation by the sea.
4-Bedroom Villa With Private Pool
Thoughtfully designed for larger gatherings, the four-bedroom villa combines space, privacy, and elegance. With expansive interiors, a private pool, and generous shared areas, it sets the stage for meaningful moments and an elevated beachside experience at Cua Sot.

Vinpearl Water Park Ha Tinh
The largest water park in the North Central region with 8 challenging super speed slides and many other exciting water experiences.
Dong Loc junction
Dong Loc junction is a historical relic associated with 10 young female volunteers soldier who died in the Vietnam War during a US Air Force bombing here.
Huong Tich Pagoda
Huong Tich Pagoda is located at the top of Huong Tich mountain part of the Hong Ling Mountains range in Ha Tinh with an altitude of 650m above sea level. This place worships Yin Yin bodhisattva.
